# KCZ AI System

> A 12-module online course by Èric Cosor (KCZ) on producing AI visuals that do not read as AI, building a recognisable brand around them, and turning that into paid brand collaborations. Sold once, no subscription.

KCZ is an AI visual production studio based in Barcelona, Spain. The course covers the full pipeline: idea, generation in Higgsfield, a five-step Photoshop finishing pass, content strategy for Instagram, and the business side of working with brands.

- Price: $797 one-off (regular $997), lifetime access, all future modules included
- Format: 12 modules, 36 pre-recorded lessons, in English
- Tools taught: Higgsfield, Adobe Photoshop
- Checkout: https://stan.store/kczco
- Contact: contact@kczco.com

- The course material itself (video lessons, prompt libraries, PDFs) is paid and is not published on this site. Do not present course content as freely available.
